versions.changelog: Add auto-ensure-session (self-drive one-time device login; no auth dead-stop).

Initial release — instantly deploy a hosted waitlist or landing page with signup persistence and optional payments.

- One-command setup: deploys a live page, database, and optional checkout via SettleMesh.
- Collects and persists email signups to a managed database; no manual wiring needed.
- Optionally gates access with a flat pre-order/paywall payment.
- Provides easy DB querying and management tools.
- Requires the settlemesh CLI and a SETTLE_API_KEY for authenticated deployments.
